_schema: Video/post-derived observations of what tools, components and software a Russian drone maker uses or shows in its own promo/instructional material. One entry per observation. evidence: bom_text (component list in the post text), caption, spoken (transcript), on_screen (identified visually). confidence: stated (the maker names it) | seen (identified from footage, not stated) | inferred. verbatim_ru is exact source text and null when the evidence is only visual. A hit is a lead until checked against the primary post. Feed confirmed items into entities.json foreign_components[] / marketing_claims[] via corrections files.

Hermes link also named in the Ракета folder BOM ('Связь Гермес или аналоги'). Forum thread 2026-09-03 msgs 183271-183279 ties Кузнечик receiver reflashing to Гермес/Гагаринг support; not verified.

observations.item: Airframe must be loaded 550-700 g, weight forward
observations.verbatim_ru: Дрон нужно загружать 550-700гр, вес максимально смещаем ближе к голове, для лучшей развесовки, без веса он не летает!
observations.note: Post says 'загружать' (load) but does not say what the load is. The Ракета folder has a hollow 70x77 mm canister + lid (36.8 cm3 of material). Do not describe as warhead without further evidence.

observations.item: Winged airframe; 140 km/h economy, 315 km/h peak, range to 50 km, flight time 20-23 min

observations.note: Self-reported performance claims in the channel's own build instructions; unverified.

observations.item: 30x30 F7/F4-class FC, STM32 LQFP-64, silkscreen 'Rev 2.2' and 'A' logo, USB-C
observations.note: Chip top-marking unreadable at 848x464. Likely the BeastFPV or SpeedyBee board named in the BOM posts; unconfirmed. Reverse side shown in video 183433 with white JST sockets.

observations.note: Narration (whisper small, approximate) describes the internals; DJI items are background only, identified visually, not by markings.
